description:
ServiceNow Developer 
 Corporate Headquarters 
 12575 Uline Drive, Pleasant Prairie, WI 53158 
 Are you a ServiceNow developer who enjoys building solutions and improving business processes? Join Uline as a ServiceNow Developer and help design, develop and enhance our ServiceNow platform, delivering scalable applications and workflows that support our growing North American company.
 Careers Packed with Potential. Backed by 45+ years of success, Uline offers opportunities to grow your career with stability you can count on.
 Position Responsibilities 
 Design, develop and maintain ServiceNow applications, modules, and workflows to support business objectives.
 Configure and customize the ServiceNow platform using scripting, integrations, and low-code development tools.
 Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into technical solutions.
 Develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and other enterprise systems to improve data flow and automation.
 Test, troubleshoot and resolve platform issues while ensuring application performance and reliability.
 Create and maintain technical documentation, development standards, and best practices for ongoing platform support.
 Minimum Requirements 
 Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related field.
 ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) preferred.
 3+ years of experience developing and supporting ServiceNow applications preferred.
 Strong knowledge of JavaScript, ServiceNow development tools, integrations, and platform customization.
 Experience with ITSM, ITIL processes and ServiceNow workflow automation preferred.
 Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills.
 Uline does not participate in the H-1B lottery.
 Benefits 
 Complete health insurance coverage and 401(k) with 6% employer match that starts day one! 
 Multiple bonus programs.
 Paid holidays and generous paid time off.
 Tuition Assistance Program that covers professional continuing education.
 Employee Perks 
 On-site café and first-class fitness center with complimentary personal trainers.
 Over four miles of beautifully maintained walking trails.
 About Uline 
 Uline, a family-owned company, is North America’s leading distributor of shipping, industrial, and packaging materials with over 10,000 employees across 15 locations.
 Uline is a  drug-free workplace . All new hires must complete a pre-employment hair follicle drug screening . All positions are on-site.
